title: Catan
statementMd:
Fred is a professional Catan player. In this board game, players collect resources to build cities and roads. After so many games, he is confident he could find a job in construction if he ever wanted a career change. Today, he wants to broaden his experience by building as many roads as possible!

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b6041a1a062c55c2dd3d22f7f22c3b3e635000a5.png)

To build a road, Fred must spend one lumber card and one brick card. He currently has $m$ lumber cards and $t$ brick cards. If he runs short of either resource, he can trade with the bank: four lumber cards for one brick card, or four brick cards for one lumber card. He may make as many of these trades as he likes.

Help Fred determine the maximum number of roads he can build using his cards and these trades.

## Input

The input consists of one line containing two integers $m$ and $t$ ($0 \le m,t \le 10^{9}$), Fred's numbers of lumber and brick cards, respectively.

## Output

Print a single integer: the maximum number of roads Fred can build.

## Note

**Explanation for example 1**

Fred builds three roads, trades four lumber cards for one brick card, and builds a fourth road.

**Explanation for example 2**

If Fred trades all four lumber cards, he will have no lumber left to build a road.
statementZhMd:
Fred 是一名专业的卡坦岛玩家。在这款桌游中，玩家收集资源来建造城市和道路。经过如此多场游戏后，他相信如果有一天想换个职业，自己也能在建筑行业找到一份工作。今天，他想通过建造尽可能多的道路来拓展自己的经验！

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b6041a1a062c55c2dd3d22f7f22c3b3e635000a5.png)

建造一条道路需要消耗一张木材卡和一张砖块卡。他目前有 $m$ 张木材卡和 $t$ 张砖块卡。如果某种资源不足，他可以与银行进行交易：用四张木材卡换一张砖块卡，或用四张砖块卡换一张木材卡。他可以进行任意多次这样的交易。

请帮助 Fred 求出利用手中的卡片及这些交易最多能建造多少条道路。

## 输入格式

输入包含一行，两个整数 $m$ 和 $t$（$0 \le m,t \le 10^{9}$），分别表示 Fred 拥有的木材卡和砖块卡数量。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示 Fred 最多能建造的道路数量。

## 说明

**样例 1 解释**

Fred 建造三条道路，用四张木材卡换取一张砖块卡，然后建造第四条道路。

**样例 2 解释**

如果 Fred 换出全部四张木材卡，他将没有剩余的木材卡来建造道路。
